name: La Dolce Vita  Orient Express
insider_take: Step aboard the legendary Orient Express reimagined as Rome's most exclusive boutique retreat, where Art Deco glamour meets Italian sophistication in the heart of the Eternal City.
whats_special: This extraordinary hotel captures the golden age of luxury rail travel with authentic Orient Express carriages transformed into sumptuous suites. Each room features original 1920s fixtures, hand-crafted Italian leather furnishings, and panoramic windows overlooking Rome's ancient rooftops. The property's crown jewel is its rooftop dining car restaurant, offering 360-degree views of the Vatican and Colosseum.
pro_tip: Book the "Venice Simplon" suite for an authentic sleeping car experience complete with fold-down beds and original brass fittings, plus priority reservations at the hotel's exclusive "Platform 9¾" speakeasy hidden behind a vintage train door.
dont_miss: The daily "Conductor's Tour" featuring the hotel's collection of authentic Orient Express memorabilia, and evening aperitivos in the restored Pullman Bar car where Hemingway supposedly penned love letters. The hotel's location also puts you within walking distance of the Spanish Steps and Trevi Fountain.
pros: Iconic Orient Express heritage with luxury train-inspired design
Prime Rome location near major attractions
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Elegant suites with sophisticated vintage-modern décor
cons: Limited availability due to boutique size
